Routine Desk Review

I reviewed a normal shift at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways and found the work followed the standard safe process. Travelers came to the counter for routine service, and the desk staff checked the booking details, carrier notes, and animal comfort needs before any transfer was arranged. One traveler asked for a small change to the service record, and the update was entered in the desk ledger right away so the file stayed current. The handlers used calm, humane methods throughout, giving the animals space, steady voice cues, and slow movements to avoid stress.

The safety coordinator then looked over the desk area for any handling hazards and confirmed that the prevention steps were in place. No unusual behavior was seen, and the work stayed orderly from start to finish. I watched the team keep doors clear, keep paperwork matched to the right traveler, and confirm that the animals were settled before the next step.

Follow-up is simple: keep using the same calm handling approach, keep the ledger entries clear, and keep the hazard review part of the regular desk check so the station stays safe and predictable.
